items.name: Masterwork
items.description: RuneScape 3 masterwork equipment, organised item-by-item following RS Wiki craft recipes. Except for 529 apex hides and approximately 115 raw Havenhythe meat/sinew equivalents, all counters start at zero AS UNRECORDED PLACEHOLDERS, not verified bank quantities. Track stages carefully: processed intermediates and raw inputs represent the SAME resources. Additional sets are independent goals. Main index: https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_equipment

children.name: Ranged armour & cape
children.description: Level 110 Crafting, plus completed 'It Should Have Been Called Chinskin'. One shared supply tally prevents hides/sinew being counted repeatedly. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.name: Apex hide +5 unlock
children.description: Unlock chain: 384 apex hides/leather plus 12 apex sinew. Existing 529 hides are accounted for in the single shared counter here. https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: Apex hides (achievement uses 384; also used for 120 ranged armour)
children.description: Shared total 384 for apex +5 and 120 for masterwork ranged plates. 529 last confirmed. Do NOT add the 384 and 120 again elsewhere.

children.name: Apex hide cowl +5
children.description: 64 apex leather and 2 apex sinew.  Listed individually; leather and sinew are shared materials, not owned five times. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: Apex hide body +5
children.description: 160 apex leather and 5 apex sinew. Also 1 steel stud and 1 steel bar. Listed individually; leather and sinew are shared materials, not owned five times. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: Apex hide chaps +5
children.description: 96 apex leather and 3 apex sinew. Also 1 steel stud. Listed individually; leather and sinew are shared materials, not owned five times. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: Apex hide vambraces +5
children.description: 32 apex leather and 1 apex sinew. Also 1 steel stud. Listed individually; leather and sinew are shared materials, not owned five times. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: Apex hide boots +5
children.description: 32 apex leather and 1 apex sinew.  Listed individually; leather and sinew are shared materials, not owned five times. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: It Should Have Been Called Chinskin completed
children.description: Craft and upgrade all five apex hide items to +5. Unlocks masterwork ranged crafting; 100 Crafting. https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: Sinew supply (armour + cape + unlock)
children.description: These are transformations of the SAME resources, not additional apex sinew demands. Keep the raw/processed numbers reconciled when updating. https://runescape.wiki/w/Spinning_wheel

children.name: Raw Havenhythe meat / apex sinew equivalent
children.description: ~115 last reported, unverified current balance. Counts usable raw meat OR apex sinew in one combined approximation; do not add it twice. Needs 12 for +5 unlock, 240 for armour, 10 for cape. Process each meat into apex sinew.

children.name: Regular sinew for masterwork sinew
children.description: Need 2 regular sinew per batch of 10 masterwork sinew, 125 batches for 1,250.

children.name: Masterwork sinew crafted
children.description: For 1,200 armour + 50 cape. Every 10 masterwork sinew uses 2 apex sinew +2 regular sinew +10 thread (125 batches). The 250 apex required here plus 12 for unlock equals 262.

children.name: Regular thread for sinew
children.description: 1250 regular thread to craft 125 batches of masterwork sinew. Does not include masterwork thread consumed in making specialist leather.

children.name: Leather crafting (shared full set + cape)
children.description: Finished intermediary totals for the full ranged set AND cape. Raw recipe details appear on each type. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.name: Masterwork monochromatic dragon leather
children.description: 10 body +5 chaps +3 cowl +1 vambraces +1 boots. Each requires 8 black, 8 royal, 8 undead dragon leather, 1 dinosaur leather and 1 masterwork thread.

children.name: Masterwork elasticated leather
children.description: 3 body +2 chaps +2 cowl +1 vambraces +1 boots. Each requires 8 snakeskin, 8 carapace, 8 dagannoth hide, 1 leather and 1 masterwork thread.

children.name: Masterwork chromatic dragon leather
children.description: 1 cowl +1 cape. Each requires 8 green, 8 blue, 8 red dragon leather, 1 hard leather and 1 masterwork thread.

children.name: Masterwork thread for those leathers
children.description: 20 monochromatic +9 elasticated +2 chromatic; ingredient count already represented in leather recipes.

children.name: Ethereal draconic plates (12)
children.description: Chain: 12 glorious +12 Praesulic ranged essence +12 Sirenic essence -> 12 masterwork ranged plates -> 12 draconic plates (120 shards +120 lacquer) -> 12 lined plates (120 apex leather) -> 12 ethereal plates. https://runescape.wiki/w/Lined_draconic_plate_(unimbued)

children.name: Glorious bars for ranged plates
children.description: 12 masterwork ranged plates; one glorious bar each.

children.name: Praesulic essence (ranged)
children.description: Break down Pernix armour at dragonkin anvil for ranged essence.

children.name: Sirenic essence
children.description: Break down Sirenic armour at dragonkin anvil; full undamaged set produces 12.

children.name: Draconic shards
children.description: 12 draconic plates require 120 draconic shards (can be obtained from a draconic visage).

children.name: Lacquer
children.description: Player-owned ports lacquer; used for 12 draconic plates.

children.name: Ethereal draconic plates crafted
children.description: 12 masterwork ranged plates -> draconic plates -> lined with 120 apex leather -> imbued as ethereal draconic plates. The 120 apex leather is INCLUDED in 504-hide shared total, not another 120.

children.description: Individual final items; costs are listed in descriptions. Their supplies are pooled ABOVE, not duplicated into separate per-piece counters.

children.name: Masterwork ranged cowl
children.description: 3 monochromatic leather +2 elasticated leather +1 chromatic leather +2 ethereal draconic plates +200 masterwork sinew +1 algarum thread. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.name: Masterwork ranged chaps

children.name: Masterwork ranged vambraces
children.description: 1 monochromatic leather +1 elasticated leather +1 ethereal draconic plate +100 masterwork sinew +1 algarum thread. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.name: Masterwork ranged boots
children.description: 1 monochromatic leather +1 elasticated leather +1 ethereal draconic plate +100 masterwork sinew +1 algarum thread. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.description: 5 for five final pieces. Additional algarum thread may be needed if crafting Sirenic armour before converting it to essence.

children.name: Trimmed masterwork melee armour
children.description: T100 Trimmed Masterwork melee armour — planned for 23 Nov 2026 Late-Game Rebalance (Jagex design preview, not final recipe). T90 Masterwork armour is already OWNED as a complete 5-piece basic set (tracked under 'Melee armour') and is the upgrade input; no need to recraft it. Upgrading T90 to T100 requires 110 Smithing, completed 'It Still Should Have Been Called Aetherium' achievement, melee armour trim, and Primed Glorious Bars (EXACT NUMBER STILL UNKNOWN). Existing T92 trimmed armour automatically receives T100 stats on launch. Keep old 12-trim legacy planning counters only as provisional prep; final trim/primed-bar quantities must be checked against Nov 23 release and revised before treating this as a definitive bill of materials. https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/late-game-rebalance-design-preview

children.name: T100 upgrade — confirmed prerequisites
children.description: Confirmed requirements for upcoming T100 trimmed Masterwork upgrade (final per-piece recipes pending): full untrimmed T90 set already owned (5/5), primal +5 achievement completed, 110 Smithing still outstanding by ~1.3m XP (last reported). Existing T90 set tracked as owned elsewhere; do not count inputs twice. Primed glorious bars are confirmed but exact quantities still unknown.

children.name: Untrimmed T90 masterwork melee set owned

children.name: 110 Smithing

children.name: Trim components for the set

Jagex has NOT confirmed whether the T100 upgrade retains the same per-piece trim quantities. Primed glorious bars also required but exact number unannounced; these original counters remain unchanged for now so no prior progress is lost. https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/late-game-rebalance-design-preview

children.name: Trim individual pieces

children.name: Masterwork 2h sword
children.description:
Item-first recipe: Masterwork 2h sword = sharpened masterwork blade + masterwork sword hilt. Also requires 'It Still Should Have Been Called Aetherium' (primal armour +5). 10 primed glorious bars total (10 glorious + 1,000 primal), 10 gold bars, one extra primal bar for sword trim, 4 kalphite essence, 4 demonic essence, 4 chaotic essence, one moonstone, one undead dragon leather, one brown dye. Every component has its own input tally; no shared totals duplicated as siblings. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_2h_sword
Inventory note (17 Nov 2026): owns 2 drygore weapons and 2 Twin Furies blades. If sacrificed at a Dragonkin anvil, those yield the sword's 4 Kalphite essence and 4 Demonic essence. One drygore is currently the main-hand of the user's dual-wield setup, with an Abyssal scourge intended to replace it; verify whether the other drygore is the off-hand before dismantling. Weapons are NOT yet converted, so do not mark any essence counters completed.
